subject.title: fix(clickclack): recover when API requests stall

question: Are 30 seconds for ordinary ClickClack REST calls and 120 seconds for supported media uploads the intended compatibility budgets for existing self-hosted deployments?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but its principal remaining consequence is an intentional availability-versus-bounded-recovery policy choice that tests cannot calibrate for all deployed servers.

options.title: Accept the bounded budgets
options.body: Keep the 30-second REST and 120-second upload deadlines, accepting TimeoutError as the recovery behavior for endpoints that exceed those limits.

options.title: Adjust the deployment budgets
options.body: Change one or both constants if known ClickClack deployments require a longer documented operational envelope.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded budgets
recommendation.body: Keep the 30-second REST and 120-second upload deadlines, accepting TimeoutError as the recovery behavior for endpoints that exceed those limits.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the proposed timeout policy and can provide the immediate deployment rationale; broader area ownership was not established in the available evidence.
